summary: Updated implementation plan covering the 4 UX and functional refinements: 1) Pattern input rainbow bracket & group tag highlighting synced with group colors; 2) In-place per-group text highlighting in match preview with floating hover tooltips showing group tags instead of leading inline badges; 3) Collapsible bottom panel, per-Match row expand/collapse with Expand All / Collapse All buttons, and draggable resizable table column headers; 4) Clean, concise UI labels removing verbose prefixes like "上栏" and "下栏".
